ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels. The high-intensity pixels are predominantly concentrated in the interior of the lobes, while low-intensity pixels dominate the margins and central peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white (high-intensity) blobs occupy the mid-to-inner sections of both lobes. These regions are interrupted by small, circular low-intensity spots. The outer perimeter of the fluke is mapped as a continuous low-intensity black band approximately 15-20% of the lobe width.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50-55 degrees; the vertex is sharp and clearly defined against the water splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are present along the entire trailing edge. A significant, high-amplitude negative indentation (notch) is visible on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 2/3 of the distance from the notch to the tip. The lobe tips exhibit extreme jagged pixel irregularities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a convex curve from the median notch, transitioning to a slight concavity before reaching the distal tips, creating an overall S-curve sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular clusters are detected on the distal tips of both lobes, appearing as raised white/grey calcified textures (barnacles). Circular 'target' scars (white ring with dark center) are visible on the interior right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned linear white pixel disruptions are visible across both lobes, appearing as high-contrast rake marks that cross both dark and light pigmentation zones.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, irregular U-shaped indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, likely a result of previous physical trauma; dense barnacle colonies are present on both lobe terminals.
other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct, vertically aligned dark circular spots (oculi) are present within the white pigmentation zone of the left lobe.
